Method of Attack: Backdoor allowing remote download and execution of additional components
Aggressive ad-clicking function generating covert profit
Delayed execution of malicious code to bypass Google behavioral security scans
Attack Vector: Malicious code hidden inside Android apps on Google Play Store
Indicators of Compromise: 15 apps infected with Guerilla malware (mostly clones of popular titles)
7 apps infected with HiddnAd adware (six QR code readers and one smart compass app)
Apps passed Google safety checks by delaying malicious code execution for 6 hours
Apps removed from Google Play Store after reporting
